_why: Ratchet floors, ported from sheleg-design after its retro recorded the class: a gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit. Every script listed here reads its own floor -- two of these three were recorded and never read until SU-01.
_delta: SU-04 raised validate.py 3539 -> 3667 (+128), brand_lint_test.py 77 -> 89 (+12) and ux_lint_test.py 106 -> 133 (+27). The validate.py breakdown was MEASURED by disabling each block and re-running, not apportioned: validate_hard_rule_anchors 51 (one per derived anchor per live copy of a hard rule), validate_facts_recompute 17, validate_board_ids 14, umbrella reachability inside validate_skill_parity 9, the enum-parity widening 8, validate_ai_tell_coverage 6, the front-matter budgets 7 (two fields where one block was measured). The remaining 16 are the per-code coverage gates charging for the new codes -- a fixture row and a contract row for each of five new U codes and two new B codes -- plus the two claims validate_facts_recompute makes about facts.md itself. brand_lint_test.py: four B030 exactness fixtures, three B033, three B034, two for the multi-line template literal. ux_lint_test.py: seven for U071/U072, twelve for U073/U074 and the job layer's id uniqueness (the header check covers every entry layer), eight for U075 and the widened U070 on personas, jobs and the vision document. Every count here was produced by running something: the previous entry's own history records a run where two restated numbers were both wrong and the counted one was right.
_delta_2026_08_30: SUX-01 raised validate.py 3667 -> 4175, measured by running the gate before and after (the pre-change tree printed OK (4111)). The new checks are validate_shipped_templates (source vs plugin mirror vs per-skill seed copies, byte-for-byte plus stray refusal) and validate_shipped_paths (every backticked templates/ or scripts/ token in a shipped text resolves inside what ships). The gap between 3667 and 4111 predates this change: the floor had not been re-raised since SU-04 while the suite grew; raised to the measured count now (the last +1 is the board-id citation check the new B-030 ledger citation adds), per this file's own rule that raising is free.
